audit.why: Content whys[] correctly show Zilean ahead levels 1-5 (bomb poke, double-Q stun chain, perma-slow) and Janna taking over at 6+ once Monsoon can break his setups, matching the 51.2% win rate.
Spikes correctly name level 2 double-bomb stun chain, level 6 Chronoshift revive denial, first item perma-slow peak, late Monsoon/Tornado punish on his lack of escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side is 'Skill' on all 7 rows, disagreeing with content win[N] which already correctly names Zilean for rows 0-3 and Janna for rows 4-6. The why text for rows 0-5 was generic Janna-favor boilerplate that doesn't match the actual Zilean-favored early game.
audit.why: Zilean's Q Time Bomb (10/9.5/9/8.5/8s CD) double-detonates into a stun and his E Time Warp is a strong slow with only a 15s CD, both live from level 1-5; his R Chronoshift (120/90/60s CD) denies kills until it's down, matching content's level-6 flip to Janna once Monsoon can break his setups.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-3].side to Zilean (matching win[]) and rewrite their why to name the actual Zilean-favoring interaction. Set phases[4-6].side to Janna (matching win[]; rows 4-5 why rewritten, row 6 why already correct so left alone).

edits.before: Auto-harass with Tailwind and hold Q — your chip is real and your disengage is law.
edits.after: His bomb poke and E slow out-trade you before your kit comes online at level 1.

edits.before: W-poke the contacts; the tornado threat already taxes their engage plans.
edits.after: His double Q Time Bomb stun into E slow can chain-CC and kill your ADC.

edits.before: Full kit: shield the trades, slow the answers, and break the first real engage with Q.
edits.after: His mana-fuelled bomb poke keeps out-trading you and you cannot out-sustain it.

edits.before: Chip and shield the margins — every broken engage is a won trade your carry banks.
edits.after: His perma-slow E and short-cooldown bombs bully you off every CS-protect walk-up.

edits.before: Monsoon online — dives on your duo now end in a healing field they paid for.
edits.after: Your Monsoon disengage now starts breaking his double-bomb dive setups clean.

edits.before: First item: shields grow and the disengage toolkit compounds.
edits.after: Moonstone tips the sustain war to you as his mana starts straining.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Howling Gale answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Zilean Chronoshift (120/90/60s CD): the revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus onto him the moment it glows. - Your Q Howling Gale (14s CD) answers one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: Auto the carry, W the support, shield the answer — chip trades the wind referees.
edits.after: Hold Q for the jungler's gank window, not for chip he can just Rewind away.

edits.before: Burning Q on poke and meeting the real engage with a shrug — the tornado is the matchup.
edits.after: Time Warp gives him the getaway speed — you won't catch him past the river line.
